QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Assassin Report
QuestInfo.0: Leon looked worried after he read the documents... Go talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Leon told you that the documents were encoded. You headed back to Gilberto to see if he knew how to break the code.
QuestInfo.2: Leon told you that the documents were encoded. You headed back to Gilberto to see if he knew how to break the code. You told the prime minister everything that had occurred, but he had no idea how to break the encryption. He'll have to find someone else to help.
